# Sample sheet

```{r results='asis'}
# ---- Build DiffBind sample sheet from pipeline outputs ----
build_sample_sheet <- function(ml_dir, peak_dir) {
  tibble(bamReads = list.files(ml_dir, pattern = "\\.mLb\\.clN\\.sorted\\.bam$",
                               full.names = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(SampleID = str_remove(basename(bamReads), "\\.mLb\\.clN\\.sorted\\.bam$"),
           Peaks    = file.path(peak_dir, paste0(SampleID, ".mLb.clN_peaks.narrowPeak"))) |>
    extract(SampleID, into = c("Condition", "Replicate"),
            regex = "^(.+)_REP(\\d+)$", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE) |>
    mutate(Factor     = str_extract(Condition, "^[^_]+"),
           Treatment  = str_remove(Condition, "^[^_]+_"),
           PeakCaller = "narrow") |>
    dplyr::select(SampleID, Condition, Factor, Treatment, Replicate, bamReads, Peaks, PeakCaller)
}

dbo_file <- file.path(out_rds, "dba_counted.rds")
if (!params$recount && file.exists(dbo_file)) {
  ss <- as_tibble(readRDS(dbo_file)$samples) |>
    dplyr::select(SampleID, Condition, Factor, Treatment, Replicate, bamReads, Peaks, PeakCaller) |>
    mutate(Replicate = as.integer(Replicate))
} else {
  ss <- build_sample_sheet(ml_dir, peak_dir)

  # ---- Checks ----
  stopifnot(nrow(ss) == 24,
            all(file.exists(ss$Peaks)),
            all(file.exists(paste0(ss$bamReads, ".bai"))))
}

ko_label   <- setdiff(unique(ss$Factor), "NTC")
stopifnot(length(ko_label) == 1)
treat_lvls <- c("VEH", "AZA", "AZA_IFNg")
group_lvls <- as.vector(t(outer(c("NTC", ko_label), treat_lvls, paste, sep = "_")))

ss <- ss |>
  mutate(Factor    = factor(Factor, levels = c("NTC", ko_label)),
         Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treat_lvls),
         Condition = factor(Condition, levels = group_lvls)) |>
  arrange(Treatment, Factor, Replicate)

ss <- ss %>%
  filter_out(SampleID == "NTC_AZA_IFNg_REP2")

 print(htmltools::tagList(
    default_dt(
      ss
    )))
```

# Consensus peaks and counting (DiffBind)

```{r results='asis'}
dbo_file <- file.path(out_rds, "dba_counted.rds")

if (!params$recount && file.exists(dbo_file)) {
  dbo <- readRDS(dbo_file)
} else {
  dbo <- dba(sampleSheet = as.data.frame(ss))
  dbo$config$cores     <- params$n_cores
  dbo$config$singleEnd <- FALSE

  # ---- Remove peaks overlapping the (lifted) mm39 blacklist; no greylist (no controls) ----
  dbo <-   dba.blacklist(dbo, blacklist = import(params$blacklist), greylist = FALSE)

  # ---- Consensus: >=2 replicates within any condition ----
  dbo_cons   <- dba.peakset(dbo, consensus = DBA_CONDITION, minOverlap = 2)
  dbo_cons   <- dba(dbo_cons, mask = dbo_cons$masks$Consensus, minOverlap = 1)
  cons_peaks <- dba.peakset(dbo_cons, bRetrieve = TRUE)

  # ---- Count fragments on summit-centred windows ----
  dbo <- dba.count(dbo, peaks = cons_peaks, summits = 200,
                   score = DBA_SCORE_READS, bParallel = TRUE)
  saveRDS(dbo, dbo_file)
}

info = dba.show(dbo)
info$PeakReads <- round(info$Reads * info$FRiP)
print(htmltools::tagList(
  default_dt(
    info
  )))
```

# Count matrix and edgeR model

```{r}
# ---- Extract raw counts + peak GRanges from DiffBind ----
get_counts <- function(dbo, sample_order) {
  pk  <- dba.peakset(dbo, bRetrieve = TRUE, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  ids <- paste0(pk$CHR, ":", pk$START, "-", pk$END)
  cnt <- as.matrix(pk[, sample_order])
  rownames(cnt) <- ids
  gr <- GRanges(pk$CHR, IRanges(pk$START, pk$END), peak_id = ids)
  list(counts = round(cnt), peaks = gr)
}

cnt_obj <- get_counts(dbo, ss$SampleID)
```

```{r}
# ---- edgeR QL fit: ~ 0 + group ----
group  <- factor(as.character(ss$Condition), levels = group_lvls)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

y <- DGEList(counts = cnt_obj$counts, group = group)
keep <- filterByExpr(y, design)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)

peaks_gr <- cnt_obj$peaks[cnt_obj$peaks$peak_id %in% rownames(y)]

plotBCV(y)
```

# Differential accessibility: KO vs NTC per treatment

```{r}
# ---- Contrasts ----
contr_def  <- set_names(paste0(ko_label, "_", treat_lvls, " - NTC_", treat_lvls),
                        paste0(ko_label, "_vs_NTC_", treat_lvls))
contr_mat  <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contr_def, levels = design)
colnames(contr_mat) <- names(contr_def)
contr_mat
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# ---- Peak annotation (ChIPseeker, GENCODE) ----
txdb     <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(params$gtf, format = "gtf")
genes_gr <- import(params$gtf, format = "gtf", feature.type = "gene")
gene_map <- as_tibble(mcols(genes_gr)) |> distinct(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type)

anno_tbl <- annotatePeak(peaks_gr, TxDb = txdb, tssRegion = c(-1000, 1000),
                         level = "gene", verbose = FALSE) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(peak_id, seqnames, start, end,
            annotation = str_remove(annotation, " \\(.*$"),
            gene_id = geneId, dist_tss = distanceToTSS) |>
  left_join(gene_map, by = "gene_id")
```

```{r}
# ---- Run QL F-tests ----
run_contrast <- function(fit, contr_vec, anno_tbl) {
  glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contr_vec) |>
    topTags(n = Inf, sort.by = "none") |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("peak_id") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    left_join(anno_tbl, by = "peak_id") |>
    arrange(PValue)
}

res_list <- map(set_names(colnames(contr_mat)),
                ~ run_contrast(fit, contr_mat[, .x], anno_tbl))

res_all <- bind_rows(res_list, .id = "contrast") |>
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = colnames(contr_mat)),
         sig = case_when(FDR < params$fdr & logFC > 1 ~ "Up",
                         FDR < params$fdr & logFC < -1 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"))

# ---- Save ----
iwalk(res_list, ~ write_csv(.x, file.path(out_tab, paste0("DA_", .y, ".csv"))))
write_csv(res_all, file.path(out_tab, "DA_all_contrasts_long.csv"))
saveRDS(list(y = y, fit = fit, contrasts = contr_mat, res = res_list),
        file.path(out_rds, "edger_fit_results.rds"))
```

## DA results {.tabset}

```{r}
# ---- Peaks within gene +/- flank, with signed distance to TSS ----
build_target_table <- function(peaks_gr, genes_gr, targets, flank) {
  tg   <- genes_gr[genes_gr$gene_name %in% targets$gene_name]
  hits <- findOverlaps(peaks_gr, tg + flank)
  tss  <- start(resize(tg, width = 1, fix = "start"))
  sgn  <- ifelse(as.character(strand(tg)) == "-", -1, 1)
  q <- queryHits(hits); s <- subjectHits(hits)

  tibble(peak_id     = peaks_gr$peak_id[q],
         gene_name   = tg$gene_name[s],
         dist_tss_kb = (mid(ranges(peaks_gr))[q] - tss[s]) * sgn[s] / 1e3) |>
    left_join(targets, by = "gene_name")
}

target_peaks <- build_target_table(peaks_gr, genes_gr, targets, params$flank)

target_res <- target_peaks |>
  left_join(res_all |> select(contrast, peak_id, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, sig),
            by = "peak_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rev(targets$gene_name)),
         promoter  = abs(dist_tss_kb) <= 1)

write_csv(target_res, file.path(out_tab, "DA_target_genes.csv"))
```
